sentence_text: Thank you for joining us for the third chapter of the Just Energy Transition Module.
We invite you to interact with the closing scenario, and to reflect on how you can take action to move these ideas from ambitions into action.
Module 4 explores financial and market strategies driving the global energy transition, especially in developing countries.
It examines public-private investments, innovative financing, and market dynamics, while addressing barriers like regulatory hurdles and risks.
It also emphasizes energy finance’s broader development impacts—including gender, social, governance, and environmental dimensions—and practical solutions for scaling investment.
